record.summary: Passive.DRUMMER has no PassiveEffects entry. It is read in MovingState.update: when the unit has a full-PP no-target cast, that cast comes first; otherwise, if a target is at range it attacks as usual; otherwise, if the board holds any unit of its own team whose passive is neither DRUMMER nor INANIMATE, it calls drumBeat(pokemon, board) instead of walking toward a target. drumBeat sets the attack cooldown to a 1000 base at the unit's speed (halved speed while paralysed); if pp >= maxPP and it can cast, it casts its skill at the nearest target at sight and stops; otherwise it adds 1 to attackCount, sets targetY to -1, and gives every adjacent (8-neighbour) same-team unit that is not a DRUMMER requested PP of 2 / 3 / 5 for 1 / 2 / 3 stars (GROOKEY / THWACKEY / RILLABOOM), then runs its OnAttack effects with no target and zero damage. The PP amount is requested only: it goes through addPP with the drummer as caster, AP boost 0 and no crit, so the applied change is halved (rounded) by fatigue and is not applied at all if the receiver is silenced, protected (Rune Protect), has NO_PP_GAIN or is resurrecting; the result is clamped to 0..2 x maxPP - 1. The adjacent receiver filter excludes DRUMMER but does not exclude INANIMATE units, while the trigger filter does.
triggers: Each movement-state tick with cooldown <= 0 when the unit has no target at range and a qualifying ally exists (MovingState.update)

effects.declaredRaw: PP 2 / 3 / 5 by stars to each adjacent same-team non-DRUMMER unit
effects.scaling: none (apBoost 0, crit false); stars index the table [2, 3, 5]
effects.resolution: requested ppGained; applied by addPP: fatigue halves, silence / protect / NO_PP_GAIN / resurrecting block, clamp to 2 x maxPP - 1

effects.declaredRaw: drum when no target at range and a non-DRUMMER, non-INANIMATE ally exists
effects.resolution: branch order in MovingState.update: charm, full-PP no-target cast, target at range, drum, then movement; drum cooldown uses resetCooldown(1000, speed)

effects.declaredRaw: at pp >= maxPP and canCast inside drumBeat: cast at the nearest target at sight, no PP gain that tick
effects.scaling: not evaluated here (ability is DRUM_BEATING, separate record)
effects.resolution: no cast happens if no target at sight; canCast blocks silence, Nullify Bandanna and Teleport Next Attack

conditions: Needs no target at range and at least one living ally that is not DRUMMER and not INANIMATE; two Drummers alone do not drum.
The charm branch of MovingState comes first when the unit is charmed and can move.
The PP gain goes to adjacent allies only (not the drummer itself) and skips other DRUMMER units.
Stars of the Drummer, not of the receiver, set the amount.
record.resetBehaviour: No stored counters; attackCount is incremented each drum and cooldown is reset each time.
